method: MHWS-conditioned compound detection (tide as conditioning variable)

definition.mhws: A_M2 + A_S2 from FES2022 harmonic constants
definition.integrated_severity_index_component: sum over full-criterion days of 0.5 * [norm(Hs_d - thr_hs) + norm(SWL_d - MHWS)], daily excesses pooled domain-wide
definition.duration_status: computed and published as a diagnostic, no longer a hazard index component (AUD-06)
definition.wave_setup: not used; waves act as driver and intensity term only
